tagline: Create and update Linear issues directly from Slack conversations
metaTitle: Slack + Linear Integration: Slack Messages to Linear Issues
metaDescription: Turn Slack messages into Linear issues, track incidents from a channel, and get status updates in Slack via GAIA. See the setup steps.
intro:
Engineering teams live in Slack. Bugs get reported there, features get discussed there, and incidents get triaged there. But work tracking happens in Linear. The friction of switching between them and manually creating issues means some work never gets properly tracked.

GAIA makes Slack a first-class interface for Linear. Team members can create issues, update statuses, and check progress without leaving the conversation. GAIA also brings issue updates back into chat so the right channels are always informed when issues are resolved or status changes.

useCases.title: Create Linear issues from Slack messages
useCases.description: Any message can become a Linear issue with a simple emoji reaction or GAIA command. GAIA extracts the message content and formats it into a proper issue with title, description, and suggested priority.

useCases.title: Incident tracking from a channel
useCases.description: When an incident is being discussed in a Slack channel, GAIA creates a tracking issue automatically, links it to the thread, and updates the issue as the incident evolves.

useCases.title: Linear status updates to Slack
useCases.description: When an issue changes status, GAIA posts an update to the relevant channel or DMs the issue creator so the team knows about progress without manually checking for changes.

useCases.title: Sprint planning from chat
useCases.description: During sprint planning discussions held in chat, GAIA can create multiple issues at once from a structured list shared in the channel, saving the manual entry work.

useCases.title: Standup reporting from issue activity
useCases.description: GAIA compiles each engineer's activity (completed issues, in-progress work, blockers) and posts personalized standup summaries to the channel every morning.

howItWorks.step: Connect Slack and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Add GAIA to your Slack workspace and connect your Linear account. Specify which channels correspond to which teams and projects.
Choose how issues are created: via emoji reactions, slash commands, or GAIA monitoring specific channels for bug reports. Configure default assignees and labels for each channel.
Specify which status changes should notify which channels or users. Set your notification preferences to avoid alert fatigue while staying informed.

faqs.question: Can I update an issue's status from Slack without opening Linear?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can ask GAIA in chat to update an issue status, change assignee, add a comment, or close an issue. GAIA handles the API call and confirms the update in the same conversation.

faqs.question: How does GAIA handle linking an issue to its originating thread?
faqs.answer: GAIA adds the thread permalink to the issue description automatically, and can also post the issue URL back into the thread so both sides are linked for easy navigation.

faqs.question: Can non-engineers use this integration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Product managers, designers, and support teams can use chat to create and check issues without needing direct access or training. GAIA acts as the translation layer.
